note: The flagship example registry. `make site X=gallery` reads this to build a hover-to-play showcase from the rendered videos. Each entry: the scene source, the rendered video in out/, and gallery metadata. Add a row when you ship a new flagship example (example-*.json).

examples.title: Product Promo
examples.description: Dark Linear-style SaaS reel: a gradient hook, a typed prompt with a cursor click, feature cards that snap in staggered, a 2.5M counter, cut to a lo-fi beat.
examples.bestFor: A product launch or feature announcement.

examples.title: Swiss Grid
examples.description: Light editorial layout: huge left-aligned grotesk, a grid motif that pops in, tabular stats. Restraint and scale contrast over motion.
examples.bestFor: A brand statement, manifesto, or data story.

examples.title: Kinetic Type
examples.description: Punchy 9:16 social cut: full-bleed word slams cycling type treatments (scale, block, gradient), lime accent, cut to a hip-hop beat.

examples.title: Metallic Shimmer
examples.description: A dramatic dark backdrop: a curtain of vertical light rods with a shimmer that sweeps across (brushed metal / a lit equaliser), coloured by the brand accent, with a clean white wordmark reveal.
examples.bestFor: A bold title card or a dramatic backdrop beat.

goldSet.note: Read a SHORT specimen to learn one mechanism; read a FULL film to learn structure and pacing. Do not copy .expanded.json (machine output).
